name: Purito -Wonder Releaf Centella Daily Sun Lotion SPF50 (60ml)
description: PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen SPF50+ 60ml is a daily sunscreen formulated to meet the needs of active people. With SPF50+ and PA++++, it provides broad-spectrum defense against UVA and UVB rays. Additionally, the formula is resistant to water, sand, sweat, and sea water, making it an ideal companion for outdoor activities. Whether you're on a run, at the beach, or doing your daily activities, it ensures your skin stays protected throughout the day. Moreover, the formula contains five types of ceramides, helping to reinforce the skin’s natural barrier, preventing moisture loss and enhancing its resilience. Additionally, Centella asiatica and panthenol also help to calm the skin, reducing irritation and supporting long-term skin health. As a last note, this product's lightweight cream texture absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky or greasy residue, ensuring a pleasant and comfortable finish.
